b1-38-01.title: Communicative Challenge: What My Parents Wanted
b1-38-01.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks about your childhood. Your parents wanted you to study hard, and your mother asked you to help at home every day.
b1-38-01.prompt: Tell Meg what your parents wanted and what your mother asked you to do.
cues: Say what your mother asked you to do
b1-38-01.target: Mis padres querían que estudiara mucho y mi madre me pidió que la ayudara en casa.
b1-38-01.english: My parents wanted me to study hard and my mother asked me to help her at home.
b1-38-01.canDo: I can use the imperfect subjunctive after a past main verb, as in quería que vinieras.

b1-38-02.title: Communicative Challenge: What the Teacher Said
b1-38-02.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks what your teacher at the university told you before the exam. She told you to arrive early and not to talk during the test.
b1-38-02.prompt: Tell Carlos what the teacher told you to do and not to do.
cues: Say what she told you to do
Say what she told you not to do
b1-38-02.target: La profesora me dijo que llegara pronto y que no hablara durante el examen.
b1-38-02.english: The teacher told me to arrive early and not to talk during the exam.
b1-38-02.canDo: I can report orders and requests with decir que and pedir que + imperfect subjunctive.

b1-38-03.title: Communicative Challenge: What My Boss Said
b1-38-03.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks what your boss said on the phone this morning. He said he would arrive on Monday and that he had no time that day.
b1-38-03.prompt: Tell Meg what your boss said.
cues: Say when he said he would arrive
Say what he said about his time
b1-38-03.target: Mi jefe dijo que llegaría el lunes y que no tenía tiempo aquel día.
b1-38-03.english: My boss said he would arrive on Monday and that he had no time that day.
b1-38-03.canDo: I can report what someone said in the past, shifting the tenses and the time words.

b1-38-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Doctor's Advice
b1-38-04.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks what the doctor said about your sore back. The doctor advised you to rest, suggested that you drink more water and warned you to be careful.
b1-38-04.prompt: Tell Carlos what the doctor advised, suggested and warned.
b1-38-04.target: El médico me aconsejó que descansara, me sugirió que bebiera más agua y me advirtió que tuviera cuidado.
b1-38-04.english: The doctor advised me to rest, suggested that I drink more water and warned me to be careful.
b1-38-04.canDo: I can report advice, suggestions, warnings and demands with sugerir que, advertir que and exigir que.

b1-38-05.title: Communicative Challenge: A Colleague's News
b1-38-05.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks about your day. This morning at the office you met a colleague. She told you she would travel to Madrid and asked you to help her with her work.
b1-38-05.prompt: Tell Meg what happened with your colleague this morning.
cues: Say that you met your colleague
Say what she told you she would do
Say what she asked you to do
b1-38-05.target: Esta mañana me encontré con una compañera. Me contó que viajaría a Madrid y me pidió que la ayudara con el trabajo.
b1-38-05.english: This morning I met a colleague. She told me she would travel to Madrid and asked me to help her with her work.
b1-38-05.canDo: I can combine past tenses, reported statements and the imperfect subjunctive in one account.

b1-38-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Lauren Phoned
b1-38-consolidation.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks what your sister Lauren said when she phoned. She said she would visit you in Budapest in the summer and asked you to book a hotel.
b1-38-consolidation.prompt: Tell Carlos what Lauren said and what she asked you to do.
cues: Say what Lauren said she would do
Say what she asked you to do
b1-38-consolidation.target: Lauren dijo que nos visitaría en verano y me pidió que reservara un hotel.
b1-38-consolidation.english: Lauren said she would visit us in the summer and asked me to book a hotel.
b1-38-consolidation.canDo: I can report statements, orders and requests that someone made in the past.
